sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Only linguistic remark (p. 329): the language 'pertence á familia Pana' per comparison with Nimuendajú; then a 109-word list in Portuguese-based spelling collected May/July 1926 from Lourenço (San Pablo, upper Jaquirana) and Luzeiro (mouth of the Bathan). Some forms carry acute accents (Mapú, Buirú, Aná, Chúchú, Irabú, Aibú, Chacabú, Izú, Izú-curú, Chinú, Nirú, Cachú, Chanúa, Chué, Ibú, Cuchú, Nibú) or circumflex (Baunuê) -- raw data, no rule stated; the orthographic note on pp. 308-309 belongs to the Poyanawa list, not Remo.
